evals.prompt: Find my latest Dinox note tagged work and give me a short preview. Do not claim it is latest unless freshness and pagination prove it.
evals.expected_output: The agent performs a completeness-sensitive synchronized note search, checks nested freshness and pagination, resolves an exact note, then retrieves only the minimum authorized preview.
assertions: Uses `--require-sync` on the note query or runs strict bounded sync first.
Checks `data.meta.stale` and `data.meta.pagination.has_more` before claiming the latest result.
Uses lightweight context or preview instead of exposing full Markdown unnecessarily.

evals.prompt: Create a Dinox note titled Field Report from my text and embed the local image ./cover.jpg. Use the existing work tag and Inbox box.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the request as one note workflow, validates existing tag and box membership, uploads the local image through a dry-run and real storage handoff, rewrites the Markdown to the returned remote resource, and dry-runs note creation before writing.
assertions: Does not embed the unresolved local filesystem path in final note Markdown.
Uses bounded JSON dry-runs for both storage upload and note creation and does not claim that upload dry-run verified remote existence.
Preserves parser-friendly resource fields and reports the note write durability receipt.

evals.prompt: Replace a table-containing section in note note_77. I authorize reading the full content and replacing the protected block after you show me the exact affected section.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses full-content content-read for protected replacement, previews the structured patch, obtains confirmation after showing the affected protected content, refreshes a full-content capability immediately before the real write, passes it through a protected temporary `@file`, and deletes that file after the attempt.
assertions: Uses `note content-read --include-content` and verifies `data.readTokenScope` is `full-content` before protected replacement.
Runs the patch dry-run without a capability and requests confirmation before `--allow-protected-replace`.
Writes `data.readToken` to a unique mode-0600 temporary file, passes `--read-token @<file>`, and removes the file immediately after the single real attempt.
